subject: Cross-cloud bundled SKU: metering spec + co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@consultco.com>, Marketplace Partnerships <mp-team@cloudvendor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-cloud bundled SKU: metering spec + co-sell playbook

Jordan / Marketplace team —

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Following our call, we need to align on two parallel items so the ConsultCo bundle can publish and start co-sell motions next quarter:

1) Metering & usage reporting: we attached a suggested metering spec (redwood-cloud-bundle-metering-spec-v1.xlsx). This defines the SKU mapping, event types we’ll emit for marketplace metering (inbound inference tokens, embed calls, and reserved capacity hours), and the expected daily ingestion schema for CloudVendor and AWS metering pipelines. Can you confirm the fields you require and any sampling/aggregation rules?

2) Co-sell evidence & playbook: ConsultCo needs a short co-sell playbook (1–2 pages) that marketplace sellers can use — key messaging, qualifying signals, and the demo/talking points for the bundled offer. We attached a draft from ConsultCo; we want to produce a Redwood+ConsultCo joint version for the catalog entry.

Immediate asks:
- Jordan: can you review the metering spec and mark any incompatible fields by EOD Friday?
- Marketplace team: can you confirm the maximum file size/format for metering deliveries (CSV vs parquet) and whether we need a publisher API token for automated pushes?
- Ben / Olga / Karthik (internal): can you review the evidence checklist in section 3 of the spec and call out any missing telemetry or compliance artifacts we must include for co-sell certification?

I’ve started a HubSpot deal (HSP-77429) and uploaded the two attachments to the shared drive link below. If we get alignment this week, we can request the marketplace listing intake and target a mid-October publish.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-marketplace-evidence

Thanks — short replies appreciated.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud bundled SKU: metering spec + co-sell playbook

Thanks Naomi — appreciated. Quick responses inline: 

Metering spec: We reviewed the spreadsheet. Two asks from our side:
- For reserved capacity hours, can you add a per-region tag (e.g., region:us-east-1) so we can reconcile marketplace revenue split per region?
- We prefer parquet delivery via an S3 push for daily batches. CSVs are OK for initial trials but parquet avoids schema drift.

Co-sell playbook: The attached draft looks good. I made a few copy edits (tone toward enterprise sellers) and added a 3-step demo script focused on infra cost savings + failover. I’ve attached the updated PDF.

We can mark incompatible fields in the spec by Friday EOD — we’ll highlight the per-region tag as required, and we’ll flag sampling_rate as optional.

Jordan Hayes
VP, Alliances, ConsultCo
jordan.hayes@consultco.com
+1 (617) 555-3421

Subject: Re: Cross-cloud bundled SKU: metering spec + co-sell playbook

Hi Naomi / Jordan,

Thanks for the details. A few marketplace ops notes:
- Delivery format: parquet via S3 (gzipped) is preferred. Max single-file ~ 5GB. We support CSV for initial intake but will require a conversion job on our side.
- Publisher API token: yes — we will provision a publisher token scoped to the listing once your publisher account is linked.
- Per-region tagging: required for revenue routing. Please include a region column as Jordan suggested.
- Evidence: we need the co-sell playbook as a standalone PDF and a short 1-page one-pager for seller enablement.

Next steps: once you confirm parquet + region column, file a listing intake (Marketplace portal) and attach the one-pager. We’ll queue the technical validation (2–3 business days).

—Marketplace Partnerships Team
mp-team@cloudvendor.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Quick internal notes:
- I reviewed the metering spec and flagged three items in the spreadsheet: TTL for event retention (we should keep 90 days for marketplace reconciliation), event_id uniqueness constraints, and the region tag (we’ll emit region from the runtime router).
- For the evidence checklist: add a sample telemetry dump (1 week) and a signed SOC2 scoping statement (if available) — marketplace wants evidence of telemetry before cert. Olga, can you check whether we have a redacted SOC2 scoping note we can share?
- Ops: we can provide parquet pushes via our S3 publisher job; need credentials and an ACL policy for the marketplace bucket.

Ben
